name: Bar-breasted Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Northern australia (broome to cape york peninsula and coastal central queensland)
description: A small and distinctive honeyeater that is primarily brown and white with strong black barring on the head and chest. Barring is less obvious in juvenile birds.

name: Little Sparrowhawk
rangeDescription: Forest and thornscrub of eastern and southern africa
description: A tiny, secretive and inconspicuous hawk that flies quickly and nimbly within woodland thickets and forest while hunting small birds, other vertebrates, and insects. It has a very distinctive white rump and two pale spots on the upper tail.

name: Kirk's White-eye
rangeDescription: Grand comoro island
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird. Note the completely yellow underparts and the broad white spectacles around the eye.

name: White-thighed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Humid forest of benin to angola and uganda
description: A large canopy hornbill with a distinct white-tipped tail, a broad white outerwing with white patches within the black forewing, a white belly and vent, and a pale bill. Often seen in the canopy and subcanopy of lowland forest feeding on fruit.

name: Long-crested Eagle
rangeDescription: Savanna of sub-saharan africa
description: Large, chunky, blackish eagle with a towering, floppy crest. In flight, the wing shows much white below and less above.

name: Lafresnaye's Vanga
rangeDescription: Locally in arid subdesert of southwestern madagascar
description: Large, big-billed vanga with white underparts. Males have a black hood, and females only a black cap.

name: Sulawesi Brown Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Sulawesi foothill forest
description: A recently described streak-throated brown flycatcher. Gray-brown above and pale whitish below with broad breast streaks and a dirty throat.

name: Baker's Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Banks group and northern vanuatu
description: A large, strikingly dark pigeon with an entirely dark upperside, a purple throat, a gray head, and a chestnut belly and underwing. Found mainly on large islands above 600 meters of elevation, but occasionally coastal.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Parker's Spinetail
rangeDescription: River islands in amazon system from eastern brazil to eastern peru
description: Rusty above with pale brown underparts, a whitish throat, and a long spiky tail. Occurs on shrubby river islands favoring early successional vegetation.

name: White-lored Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela to the guianas, northern bolivia, and amazonian and eastern brazil
description: Small flycatcher of rainforest canopy. Olive with bright white or buffy wing bars and a gray head.

name: Gambaga Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Semiarid southern mali to ghana, kenya, somalia, and southwestern arabia
description: A drab flycatcher that is uncommon and localized across its range. Some of the key features include vague and blurry streaking on the breast and crown, short wings, and a bill that is dark above and pale below.

name: Rapa Shearwater
rangeDescription: Rapa island (austral islands)
description: A small black-and-white shearwater with a relatively long rounded tail and an extensively white face. Similar to Bannerman’s and Newell’s Shearwaters, but smaller, with white on the face extending above the eye.

name: Sula Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Sula islands (taliabu, seho, and mangole)
description: A large, long-tailed green fruit-dove with pale grayish underparts, except for a deep maroon undertail and a small dark throat patch. A bird of the canopy and subcanopy of forested lowlands and less often foothills.

name: White-breasted Guineafowl
rangeDescription: Upper guinea forest of southeastern sierra leone to ivory coast and western ghana
description: Small, long-tailed, mostly black guineafowl with a white ruff around the neck and a bare red head. Found on the ground in lowland rainforest.

name: Blyth's Pipit
rangeDescription: Southern siberia to mongolia, china, tibet, and northeastern india
description: A mid-sized pipit with pale brown plumage and a fine, dark bill. Strong streaking on the head, mantle, and back contrasts strongly with the pale edges of the feathers.

name: Sick's Swift
rangeDescription: Breeds from eastern bolivia southward to northern argentina and eastward to east-central brazil; partially migratory, wintering north to panama, northern colombia, northern venezuela, and suriname
description: Small swift with a uniform brown body contrasting with a pale-ochre rump and slightly paler throat. The tail is square-tipped and quite short.

name: Masked Antpitta
rangeDescription: Northern bolivia (southeastern pando and northern beni)
description: Medium-sized antpitta of floodplain forest, particularly with palmetto understory, along the confluence of the Ríos Madre de Dios and Bení in the Riberalta area. The only antpitta in range with dark chevrons on underparts or a blue-gray cap.

name: Tristram's Starling
rangeDescription: Dead sea valley and western arabia to yemen and southern oman
description: Large, long-winged, and long-tailed starling. In flight, shows large orange wing panels.

name: Bobolink
rangeDescription: Grassland and meadows of north america; winters to southern south america
description: Breeding male is distinctive with black body, white rump, and creamy nape. Females and nonbreeders are drastically different, yellow-brown with fine streaking on breast sides, and stripes on head.

name: Ruby-crowned Tanager
rangeDescription: Eastern paraguay to southeastern brazil and northeastern argentina
description: Medium-sized tanager found in the middle to upper levels of forest edges, light woodlands, plantations, and urban parks; sometimes visits feeding stations. Males are glossy black with a concealed red crown and a white spot on the shoulder.
